title: Lost History
paragraphs: “Well, since we were helped, I can’t really complain. Right, Ren? Itsuki?”
“…It’s far better than doing something foolish, thinking I can become stronger just by relying on game knowledge.”
“I agree. In the end, it looks like we’ll have to go through everything one by one.”
“Na~no! If that happens, Gaelion will sneak up on a weakened Naofumi and slip into his heart’s empty space na~no!”
“Gaelion-chan, stop that. It’ll just complicate things.”
“Na~nooo! If Naofumi does something fun with Gaelion, I won’t do it na~no!”
Father let out a sigh. Don’t make things more complicated!
“Whatever. So, after Cal Mira Island is done, the Spirit Tortoise will revive, and after defeating it, we’ll fight the Phoenix and then the Kirin, right?”
“Na~no! The yinglong is sealed inside the dragon emperor, and the seal can be broken anytime na~no. But it can also be left sealed na~no.”
“Got it, but…”
“By the way, about the Spirit Tortoise, in the first world, Ren, Itsuki, and I ended up breaking the seal using our game knowledge.”
I explained the situation that unfolded when we challenged the four spirits in previous loops. And then we lost miserably.
“Even if Ren and I don’t break the seal, will it still revive?”
“Yes, that’s how it went last time.”
“Hmm… If we could prevent that in advance… Maybe it’s faster to predict the timing, get to the location where the seal breaks, and take it down in secret.”
“We already know how to kill it.”
If you aim Brynhildr at the Spirit Tortoise’s core inside the cave and fire at maximum output, it can be defeated in one shot.
“Understood. So, the Phoenix and the Kirin will be easy… I guess? What happens after that?”
“There won’t be many major incidents after that. The only significant event is the activation in the North Ferat Great Forest.”
“…By the way, I’ve been wondering.”
Father raised his hand there.
“What is it?”
“There are three activation events in total?”
“In all the loops so far, I’ve heard of three. However, I only learned about the Drauquier Mountains in this loop.”
“Then… could there be an unknown activation event…?”
“Within the time Motoyasu-san can stay in this parallel timeline, that might be the case.”
“Na~no? Is that what you’re explaining na~no?”
Hearing Rival’s words, Father and the others shifted their gaze.
“There is no world travel. This world is being rewound na~no.”
“That’s what Rival claims, but I don’t believe it.”
I’m sure that even in the world where I disappear, Father and the others will be doing just fine. That’s a more hopeful thought.
“…Fine. I’ll just go along with that na~no.”
Rival backed down surprisingly easily. Strange. I thought he’d put up more of a fight.

“Going back to the topic, it’s better to keep the Spirit Tortoise sealed for as long as possible. If someone knowledgeable about magic and Gaelion reinforce the seal and place a stronger barrier ahead of time, it should hold for a while.”
“Is that so? Then when it comes to someone knowledgeable about magic… should we ask Trash of the Staff Hero? Or maybe ask the Queen and Melty-chan for help?”
“Ah, the one who passed away after entrusting the staff to the Queen of Melromarc. Got it… in the worst-case…”
“Gaelion-chan?”
“Nothing na~no.”
Rival’s behavior is strange. Is it still in heat? This constantly aroused dragon.

“Let’s put aside the matter of the Spirit Tortoise and the four spirits for now and go back to the previous topic. There are three activation events, right? According to the Queen, there should be three, but Motoyasu-kun, Ren, and Itsuki, could you include your game knowledge and tell us?”
In response to Father’s question, I recall the information. If I remember correctly, in the history of Emerald Online, the number of beginner assistance events, called activation events, was…
“Four.”
“There are four locations.”
“There were about four instances.”
…Silence fell upon the group.
“Um… let’s sort out the timeline.”
Father wrote down the intervals at which the activation events occurred on a piece of paper.

“According to what I heard from the Queen, this year is unusual because the activation events are occurring in shorter intervals. Based on my guess, this phenomenon is probably the world’s way of increasing its fighting strength to prepare for the waves.”
“That makes sense. With so many coincidences piling up, it’s hard to believe it’s not intentional.”
“Right. We can assume that the timing is aligned to help the heroes become stronger as quickly as possible.”
“Na~no! The fragments of the dragon emperor also contain knowledge about the activation events na~no.”
“Then… what about the possible fourth one?”
“I don’t know na~no…”
“It might be related to an uncollected fragment.”
Ren and Father nodded in agreement with Itsuki’s words.
“If we calculate starting from the Drauquier Mountains, it happens roughly every two months, right?”
“The Drauquier Mountains, Cal Mira Island, and the North Ferat Great Forest…”
“But after the North Ferat Great Forest… na~no…”
Rival trailed off. Ah, after that, there’s certainly that.
“Is there something?”
“By the logic of the Spear Hero, the time limit for the Spear Hero’s stay is approaching na~no.”
“Hmm… I guess that can’t be helped. The main concern is whether or not there’s a fourth one, right?”
Father spread out the maps of various countries, forming a world map.

“So, after cross-referencing the information I heard from Motoyasu-kun with the map, we have the Drauquier Mountains here, Cal Mira Island near the coast of Melromarc, and the North Ferat Great Forest in the neighboring country of Faubrey. Now, everyone… where was the remaining setting for the activation event in the game, the kind of outpost-like place opened by NPCs?”
“An oasis in the desert.”
“The desert.”
“It was the desert.”
…So, it overlaps again. Well, I’m not sure how much of the game knowledge applies here.

“Considering what I heard from Motoyasu-kun, the loss of historical records caused by the chaos stirred by that genius, and the changes in the political situation across countries due to the reincarnators… I wonder if there’s a fourth one somewhere.”
“Why are you so concerned about a fourth one?”
“Well, maybe it’s just the gamer in me… Even if no activation event happens, there’s still information to be gained, right?”
“The magic that can be obtained in the activated areas.”
“Yeah. Based on the pattern, it would be Liberation magic, right? Right now, I’m learning dragon vein techniques from Gaelion-chan, but don’t Ren and Itsuki think it’s worth checking out?”
Ren and Itsuki nodded in agreement with Father’s words.
“I see. If it’s just for experience points, it might not be worth it, but considering the need for confirmation, it makes sense.”
“Yeah… but the desert, huh…”
We checked the world map. There are several large deserts around the world.
“Where did it occur in the game?”
“According to the settings, it was around here.”
“Over here.”
“It’s this place.”

We each pointed to different deserts. Huh? By chance, the desert that lies between Siltvelt and Faubrey, which is accessible from both Melromarc and Faubrey, was left out. Well, it’s slightly off the mark. It’s more like the desert along the Siltvelt side. Last time, we bypassed this desert to head toward Faubrey.
“…Something about this feels oddly divided.”
“Yeah, it feels intentional.”

“The difficulty just went up all of a sudden. Then let’s narrow it down and check the areas where castles or fortresses might have been in the activated zones… Or rather, places that became deserts after once being inhabited.”
“Hmm… I think I have some memory of a country existing here from the fragments of the dragon emperor.”
Of all things, Rival pointed to a desert that none of us had indicated.
“Really?”

“Yes. It’s a very faint memory, but there was a place similar to ruins called the Dragon’s Sanctuary, which seemed to have been destroyed by something. The only one that still exists should be the Filolial Sanctuary.”
“I vaguely remember visiting that place in the first world.”
Ah, that place was paradise. I’m starting to remember. Father and I went there together to clean it.
“Then, let’s look into it again tomorrow. Since the Queen is knowledgeable about history and I have other things to ask her, we should get her opinion.”
“Investigating lost history, huh?”
“There’s a bit of romance in that. If we find the missing activation site, wouldn’t that be a major discovery?”
“Understood!”
If we can locate the activation site, it means there will be an environment where the Filolials can be raised even faster. It’s definitely worth looking into!
